name: Governance of the Relationship
title: Governance and Escalation
text: Each Party shall appoint a representative who is the principal point of contact for the Services and who has authority to take day-to-day decisions on that Party's behalf, and shall notify the other in writing of any change. The representatives shall meet at least once a quarter to review performance, changes and any matter either Party raises. A matter the representatives cannot resolve within fifteen (15) days shall be referred to a senior officer of each Party, who shall meet within a further fifteen (15) days. Decisions of the representatives bind the Parties only where recorded in writing and signed by both; nothing said at a meeting varies this Agreement unless it is recorded as an amendment. This Clause does not prevent either Party from seeking urgent interim relief, from referring a dispute to arbitration once the escalation periods have expired, or from exercising a right of termination that has accrued.

legal_basis.note: Parties must perform or offer to perform; a governance structure is the machinery by which performance is monitored and adjusted.

Where a multi-tier clause makes escalation a condition precedent, a court may decline reference until it is exhausted, so the carve-outs for urgent relief and accrued termination rights are what keep the tier from becoming a trap.

invalid_if: Escalation is drafted as an absolute condition precedent to any remedy, so that a Party in breach can delay relief by declining to meet.
The clause purports to let a governance body amend the Agreement without the formalities the amendment clause requires.
Time limits are left unstated, which makes the escalation tier incapable of being exhausted and therefore incapable of being a condition precedent at all.
authoring_note: Distinct from CORE_GOVERNANCE_PROTECTIONS_001, which confers audit, information and escalation RIGHTS; this constitutes the standing body that exercises them. Confirm the 15+15 day tiers and whether a quarterly cadence suits engagements of this size.
